question: From Linate Airport to central Milan by metro M4, how long does it take to reach San Babila, what are the operating hours and frequency, and how much is an ordinary ticket?
expected: M4 reaches San Babila in 12 minutes from Linate Aeroporto. Service runs about 05:40-00:20, every 3-6 minutes. Ordinary ticket costs EUR 2.20 and is valid for 90 minutes.

question: Compare the direct bus options from Linate Airport to Milano Centrale among Airport Bus Express, Air Pullman/Linate Shuttle, and Flibco: price and approximate journey time.
expected: Airport Bus Express/Autostradale: EUR 5, about 25 minutes from Centrale. Air Pullman/Linate Shuttle: EUR 7, about 25-30 minutes. Flibco: EUR 7, about 25-30 minutes, roughly hourly departures.

question: For the Summer School Residence Ambassador role in July 2026, who is eligible, what benefit is offered, what availability is required, and when/how should students apply?
expected: Eligible students are adults, already residence hall guests as of June 27, 2026, interested in staying in Milan in July 2026, and willing to contribute to the community. Selected ambassadors stay in their original residence until July 27, 2026 free of charge and receive EUR 500. Availability is required July 5 morning to July 18 afternoon. Apply by emailing housing@unibocconi.it from February 23 to March 8, 2026.

question: For the 2026-27 Olympic Village freshmen housing opportunity, what room type, monthly fee, deposit, and assignment period are specified?
expected: Single room with private bathroom, EUR 986/month. Security deposit equals two months' rent. Assignment period is August 24, 2026 to July 23, 2027, 11 months. The fee includes utilities, internet, weekly cleaning with linen change, study/activity/relaxation areas, and 24-hour concierge.

question: Can I reserve one Olympic Village room and one Bocconi residence room in different 2026-27 assignment sessions, then decide later which one to keep?
expected: No. Once a room has been reserved in any assignment session, it is not possible to reserve another one. Students who confirm a reservation cannot later withdraw from it in order to participate in a subsequent session.

question: How do I access Bocconi Library and reserve a study seat? Mention the yoU@B options and whether booking is mandatory.
expected: From yoU@B students can generate a temporary QR code as an alternative to the Bocconi ID Card, view/accept the Library seat rules, and reserve a study seat or Phone Booth through Study Places/Desk Finder. Booking a study seat is mandatory for the entire stay.

question: What were the Bocconi Library building opening hours for May 4-17, 2026, and when do closing procedures start?
expected: For each day listed from May 4 through May 17, 2026, the Library building/reading rooms/Phone Booths/Data Room were open 8:30-24. Closing procedures start 30 minutes before the indicated time.

question: What medical certificate is valid for Bocconi Sport registration, and how must it be submitted?
expected: Accepted options are a non-competitive sports medical certificate with a valid ECG, issued by a Sports Medicine Center, sports medicine specialist, or GP/family doctor, or a competitive sports certificate issued by a Sports Medicine Center. If issued by a GP/family doctor, a signed self-declaration is required. Recreational/motor activity certificates and Virgin Active certificates are not accepted. Upload via the you@B app widget Bocconi Sport > Medical Certificate.

question: Where and when are in-person Bocconi Counseling walk-ins available, and what emergency contacts does the page list?
expected: Walk-ins are Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays from 3 to 7 p.m. at Room 3, Campus Life Space, via Bocconi 12, mezzanine floor. Counseling email is counseling@unibocconi.it and phone is 02 5836 2083. Out of hours/closures: International SOS +33(0)155 633 155. Emergencies: 112 for medical/psychological emergency, 1522 for violence/stalking support.

question: Summarize the Music Room rules: who can use it, where it is, opening hours, annual fee validity, daily booking limit, and no-show penalty.
expected: Only Bocconi internal users can use it. It is in via Bocconi 12, floor -1 outside the Residence. Open Monday-Sunday 11 a.m.-2 p.m. and 5 p.m.-10 p.m. The one-off fee is EUR 30.50, valid for the academic year July-June until June regardless of payment month. Max 2 one-hour sessions per day. After three no-shows without cancellation, reservations are blocked for 15 days and future reservations are cancelled.

question: For Free Mover Summer 2026, when must undergraduate students apply, what must they upload, and how many Summer Programs can they indicate?
expected: Apply at Punto Blu from April 27, 2026 through July 17, 2026. Upload a valid English certificate if not already registered and the Free Mover Summer 2026 - Student info document. Save the application receipt. Students can indicate one Summer Program only.

question: For the Bocconi Graduate Exchange Program 2026-27, what are the minimum GPA and credits requirements, and what exam cutoff date is used?
expected: Minimum GPA is 22/30 weighted on credits, not rounded. At least 16 credits must be registered. GPA and credits are based on Bocconi exams taken by the end of the winter exam session, February 3, 2026 for AY 2026/27 selection; grades must be registered before the application closes.

question: For incoming exchange students in Fall 2026, when is course selection, when is add/drop, how many courses may they select, and can they add language courses?
expected: Course Selection for Fall AY 2026-2027 runs August 24-26, 2026 through yoU@B, first come-first served with no waiting list. Add/Drop is September 7-15, 2026. Exchange students must enroll in minimum 1 and maximum 5 courses per semester. They cannot add language courses to their study plan.

question: What are the two main visa-process steps for non-EU exchange students, and what should they enter/upload in Universitaly Step B and Step C?
expected: Main steps: pre-register/submit on Universitaly, then apply for a Study Visa. Step B: enter passport number/expiration, upload passport personal-data page and passport-size picture, select country and Italian Embassy/Consulate, reason as mobility for study/traineeship, select Universita Commerciale Luigi Bocconi, course type Corsi Singoli, course name Exchange Program. Step C: submit Bocconi acceptance letter, choosing Other and typing Bocconi Acceptance Letter as qualification name.

question: If I am selected for a Double Degree, can I stop paying Bocconi fees while abroad because the host institution tuition is waived?
expected: No. Selected students do not pay tuition to the host institution, but they must pay Bocconi an administrative contribution of EUR 2,000 and continue paying Bocconi fees while abroad.

question: For the Bocconi MSc Finance placement page, what are the one-year-after-graduation employment and abroad-work figures, and what are the graduation-day figures for employment, abroad work, interviews, and offers?
expected: One year after graduation: 93% employed and 63.9% of employed graduates work abroad. On graduation day: 82.2% employed, 61.2% of employed graduates work abroad, average 5.9 job interviews, average 2.1 job offers.

question: Compare one-year placement for MSc Finance and MSc Data Science and Business Analytics: employment rate, share working abroad, and continuing-studies figure if available.
expected: Finance: 93% employed, 63.9% of employed graduates work abroad. DSBA: 93.2% employed, 39% of employed graduates work abroad, and 12% are continuing their studies. Finance source does not list a continuing-studies figure in the same section.

question: On the first day of an internship, what must happen to the internship document so the internship is valid?
expected: The regulating document must be printed, signed by the student and employer/legal representative or delegate, and sent to the University. It can be printed from JobGate by the employer or yoU@B by the student. The original must be mailed/couriered to the Internship Office or hand-delivered to the Bocconi Post Office at Viale Bligny 12, Mon-Fri 8:30-16:30. The student must verify submission. For internships outside Europe, a scan via B in touch is accepted, but the original must be delivered after return to Italy.

question: What internship types does the Bocconi Career Services page distinguish?
expected: It distinguishes curricular internships before graduation, curricular internships for credits, curricular internships without credits, and extracurricular internships after graduation. A second 6-credit internship can be completed only for Bachelor of Science and Law programs as an additional internship.

question: Can Bocconi directly activate an extracurricular internship in Lazio or Emilia Romagna?
expected: No. The page states Bocconi University does not directly activate extracurricular internships in Emilia Romagna or Lazio.
